UserPromptSubmit.command: node -e "console.log('✓ Code quality hooks initialized for SUECA project')"

PostToolUse.command: powershell -Command "if ($env:VSCODE_WORKSPACE_FOLDER) { $files = @(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Include '*.ts', '*.tsx' | Where-Object { $_.FullName -like '*frontend*' }); if ($files.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host '💡 Tip: Run `yarn format` in frontend/ to format TypeScript files'; exit 0 } }"
